**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/06/11 (Sun) 22:24
- [FACT] The user has been sticking to a daily tidying routine for 3 weeks.
- [EVENT] The user needs help organizing their garage this weekend.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant congratulated the user on their accomplishment of maintaining a daily tidying routine for 3 weeks.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided tips for organizing the garage, including:
  1. Prepare for the task by setting aside time and gathering supplies.
  2. Purge before organizing by sorting items into categories.
  3. Categorize and group similar items together.
  4. Assign a home for each category.
  5. Use vertical space for storage.
  6. Label everything for easy identification.
  7. Keep frequently used items accessible.
  8. Consider a "maybe" box for indecisive items.
  9. Take breaks and stay focused.
  10. Clean and organize the floor after organizing.
- [USER] The user expressed feeling proud of their tidying routine and asked for tips on sorting through boxes and storage bins.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided additional tips for deciding what to keep and what to get rid of, including:
  - The 4-Box Method: Keep, Donate/Sell, Recycle, Toss.
  - Questions to ask when deciding on items.
  - Common items to consider getting rid of.
  - Tips for letting go of items.
